name: Raene's Cleansing
summary: In Ashenvale, Raene Wolfrunner and Shael'dryn seek Dartol's Rod's final piece. They hope the relic can help cleanse the forest and slow the furbolg attacks on its night elves.

sections.title: The Ruins of Dor'Danil
sections.body: The iron pommel of Dartol's Rod was entrusted to the night elf druids at Dor'Danil barrow den. Disaster struck the sanctuary, and its caretakers were slain. With their refuge overrun, the pommel's hiding place was lost. Scavengers and wandering oozes now consume what remains in the ruins east of the southern road.

sections.title: Rebuilding Dartol's Legacy
sections.body: Dartol was an evil wizard who has since died, but the rod he made holds transformative powers. Raene Wolfrunner and Shael'dryn seek to reassemble it, hoping it can help slow the furbolg attacks on Ashenvale's night elves. The iron pommel is the final piece Shael'dryn needs before she can try to mend the fractured rod at the moonwell.

faq.answer: The iron pommel is the final piece of Dartol's Rod. Without it, the relic cannot be reforged or channeled to cleanse Ashenvale.

faq.q: What happened to the druids of Dor'Danil?
faq.answer: The druids at Dor'Danil barrow den were slain when their sanctuary fell. Their refuge now lies abandoned to lurking oozes and beasts, and Shael'dryn finds their fate painful to discuss.
Dor'Danil lies in southern Ashenvale, east of the main road toward the Barrens border and south of Splintertree Post.
Shael'dryn is a dryad who tends a sacred moonwell in Ashenvale. She helps Raene Wolfrunner track down the scattered pieces of Dartol's Rod and guides their repair.

faq.q: Why is the pommel swallowed by oozes?
faq.answer: After the barrow den fell, gelatinous slimes infested the area and consumed discarded relics, chests, and corpses. The oozes engulfed the iron pommel along with the other debris.

faq.q: What happens after finding the pommel?
faq.answer: When you return the pommel to Shael'dryn, she can begin repairing the rod. Once mended, it can help Raene Wolfrunner cleanse the forest.

angles.text: As a druid, you see the losses the Cenarion Circle and Kaldorei druids have suffered in Ashenvale when you visit Dor'Danil's desecrated grounds.
As a night elf, recovering Dartol's heirloom honors Dor'Danil's fallen caretakers and the defense of ancient Kaldorei lands.
As an Alliance member, you know Ashenvale's defense against corruption matters to the Alliance's hold on northern Kalimdor, with Horde forces advancing from Splintertree.
